name: Welcome
heading: Hi {{name}}, welcome to Your Company! 💪
intro:
Your team can now create digital work orders, monitor the status of operations, and track work completion with just a few clicks.

To make sure you have full access to our core features, we have upgraded you to our Premium plan for 30 days at no cost to you.
details:
## ❗ Action needed

**Log in and finish setting up your account**

Here is a quick guide to get you going:

💻 **Log in:** Access your account on [desktop](https://example.com/login) or via the [mobile app](https://example.com/mobile).

👀 **Explore your account:** Check out the layout and features. Need help? Enrol in our [introduction course](https://example.com/course).

👤 **Invite your team:** Bring your team on board by inviting them to join.

🛠️ **Start creating work orders:** Once your team is set up, begin creating and assigning work.

Remember, consistency matters! Log in daily to stay updated on work orders, schedules, and equipment status.
panelText: Questions about set up or what is included in your Premium trial? [Click here to book a meeting](https://example.com/meeting) for a platform walkthrough and details on plans and features.
